restaurantName: Laura Ashley The Tea Room at Villiers Hotel
bio: Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea at Laura Ashley The Tea Rooms, set within the lovely surroundings of the 4-star Villiers Hotel.  Tucked inside the historic market town of Buckingham, Villiers Hotel is an impressive 18th-century building housing the iconic Laura Ashley The Tea Room. With its floral-patterned walls, pastel decor and elegant seating, Laura Ashley The Tea Room is the perfect setting to while away the afternoon whilst enjoying this quintessential Great British tradition.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises a mouth-watering selection of sweet and savoury delights. Begin with delicate finger sandwiches, followed by freshly-baked fruit scones and finish with a tempting array of sweet treats. All of this is accompanied by your choice of loose leaf tea and, if you're feeling decadent, a glass of Prosecco or Champagne!  Villiers Hotel can be found in the centre of Buckingham, just 15 minutes from Milton Keynes Central Station and a short drive from Bicester Village.
pageTitle: Laura Ashley The Tea Room at Villiers Hotel
